faces.name: Contact Other Plane
faces.oracleText:
Roll a d20.
1—9 | Draw two cards.
10—19 | Scry 2, then draw two cards.
20 | Scry 3, then draw three cards.

faces.name: Contagion
faces.oracleText:
You may pay 1 life and exile a black card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Distribute two -2/-1 counters among one or two target creatures.

faces.name: Contagion Clasp
faces.oracleText:
When this artifact enters, put a -1/-1 counter on target creature.
{4}, {T}: Proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

faces.name: Contagion Dispenser
faces.oracleText:
When Contagion Dispenser enters, proliferate.
Whenever you proliferate during your turn, draft a card from Contagion Dispenser's spellbook. This ability triggers only once each turn.

faces.name: Contagion Engine
faces.oracleText:
When this artifact enters, put a -1/-1 counter on each creature target player controls.
{4}, {T}: Proliferate twice. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there. Then do it again.)

faces.name: Contagious Nim
faces.oracleText: Infect (This creature deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters and to players in the form of poison counters.)

faces.name: Contagious Vorrac
faces.oracleText: When this creature enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal a land card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. If you didn't put a card into your hand this way, proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

faces.name: Containment Breach
faces.oracleText: Destroy target artifact or enchantment. If its mana value is 2 or less, create a 1/1 black and green Pest creature token with "When this token dies, you gain 1 life."
